title: Paraguay: review of languages, missions, the war, the Chaco and tereré

items: I can review stance adverbs, contrast connectors, the passive, side remarks and relative clauses on Paraguayan topics.
I can use the words for Guaraní, the missions, the war, the Chaco and tereré.
I can read about Paraguay and answer questions about what the texts say.
I can correct an assumption about Guaraní and Spanish with stance adverbs such as *en realidad* and *en rigor* (review).
I can set two views of the Jesuit missions side by side with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque* (review).
I can say what was signed, taken or occupied in the Triple Alliance War with *ser* + participle (review).
I can add a side remark about the Chaco with *por cierto* or *a propósito de* and come back to my point (review).
I can describe tereré and the guarania with *en el que*, *con la que* and *del que* (review).
